verdict.rationale: Bruno's marketing page claims it can 'Serve realistic mock responses while you build,' suggesting some mocking capability, but there is no documentation detail on how mocks are created from saved examples or a spec, no dedicated docs page, and no community corroboration of this feature actually working. missing for 10: dedicated mock-server docs/CLI reference, spec-driven mock generation details, hands-on or community validation of the mocking feature.
